title: Western Rider and Landscape Sketch
coreRelationships: The large, dark figure of the rider and horse dominates the right side, creating a strong focal point.
The distant mesa and smaller figures provide context and depth to the vast, open landscape.
The rough, sketchy lines and textured background unify the entire composition, suggesting a raw, unpolished aesthetic.
The contrast between the dark, detailed foreground elements and the lighter, simpler background elements guides the eye.
reuseFormula: Recreate the monochrome, hand-drawn illustration of a Western rider and landscape, ensuring the sketch-like texture and high contrast are preserved. Integrate custom-lettered text in a similar hand-drawn, all-caps sans-serif style, positioned in the upper left, maintaining its irregular character and black fill on the textured background.
